title: fix-stream-handler-make-readable
userStory: As a user, I want the texture atlas preview in the UI to display correctly even after atlases have been converted to BC7 format, so that the atlas manager panel shows the correct images.
background: GameUIResourceHandlerOverrides.BeforeOnResourceStreamRequest (line ~106) calls textureAtlas.Main_preview.EncodeToPNG() directly. After BC7 conversion, Main_preview is a GPU-only BC7 texture (isReadable=false), so EncodeToPNG() returns empty or corrupt data. The non-streaming handler BeforeOnResourceRequest already correctly uses MakeReadable(out isCopy) and destroys the copy. The streaming handler needs the same fix.
implementationNotes: In GameUIResourceHandlerOverrides.BeforeOnResourceStreamRequest, in the '_textureAtlas' branch: replace 'textureAtlas.Main_preview.EncodeToPNG()' with the MakeReadable pattern. Call MakeReadable(out bool isStreamCopy), encode to PNG, then if isStreamCopy destroy the temp. The StreamReader receives the PNG bytes. Pattern matches BeforeOnResourceRequest lines 62-66.
dod: Temp texture is destroyed after encoding if isCopy is true
No null-ref or empty-response when atlas is BC7-compressed
